$comment: CI performance budget (docs/spec/increment-1.md, Non-functional requirements). The only place these numbers live; scripts/perf-budget.ts reads them. Throttling is Lighthouse's devtools profile: a 10 Mbit/s link, 40 ms latency, no CPU slowdown. The three limits of the spec, plus the long-task bound of plan §7 line 1 (b): no main-thread task of that length or more may start between the title-screen-interactive and world-playable marks (ADR 0010: 100 ms, measured).
